spans.s: Mathurā, a city, the present Muthra. § 273 (Rājasūyārambhap.): II, 14, 609 (the city of the Yādavas, from which they fled from fear of Jarāsandha), 632 (ºṃ samparityajya, sc. the Yādavas).--§ 275 (do.): II, 19, 763, 764 (Jarāsandha hurled a mace toward M.; the place near M. where it fell down is named Gadāvasāna).--§ 641 (Rājadh.): XII, 101, 3737 (ºm abhitaś ca ye, are skilful in fighting with the bare arms).--§ 717b (Nārāyaṇīya): XII, 340, 12954 (Nārāyaṇa will take birth as Kṛshṇa in M.).
Māthuradeśya, adj. (“originating from the country of Mathurā”). § 253 (Haraṇāharaṇap.): I, 221, 8006 (dogdhrīṇāṃ).
